name: designprint
description: Print for AI agents. Shows ready-made templates for business cards, flyers, postcards, posters, brochures, menus, invitations, stationery and tickets, and opens the one you pick in an editor with your details on it. Also makes business cards in the chat and prints a finished design at an exact size. One link to pay as a guest. Ships within the United States.
suggestedPrompts: Show me business card templates for a real estate agent
I need a flyer for my Saturday market
Print this poster at 18 x 24 inches and ship it to me
